# Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
## Participant-level data and clustered inference
# The decision blocks of a participant are not independent; these helpers are used by every test that would otherwise
# treat them as independent observations (see SI Appendix Tab. S3)

# One observation per participant: eta_n, the median of the participant's block-level estimates eta_ng.
# Further grouping variables (participant characteristics) are kept.
to_participant_level <- function(data, ...) {
    data %>%
        group_by(participant_code, ...) %>%
        summarise(eta = median(eta), .groups = "drop")
}

# Coefficient table of an lm() fit with cluster-robust (CR1) standard errors and a t distribution with G - 1 degrees
# of freedom (G = number of clusters)
cluster_robust_coefs <- function(model, cluster) {
    X <- model.matrix(model)
    stopifnot(nrow(X) == length(cluster)) # Clusters must align with the observations used in the fit
    n <- nrow(X)
    k <- ncol(X)
    G <- n_distinct(cluster)
    bread <- solve(crossprod(X))
    meat <- crossprod(rowsum(X * residuals(model), cluster))
    se <- sqrt(diag(G / (G - 1) * (n - 1) / (n - k) * bread %*% meat %*% bread))
    tibble(term = colnames(X),
           estimate = unname(coef(model)),
           std.error = unname(se),
           statistic = estimate / std.error,
           p.value = 2 * pt(-abs(statistic), df = G - 1),
           conf.low = estimate - qt(0.975, df = G - 1) * std.error,
           conf.high = estimate + qt(0.975, df = G - 1) * std.error,
           n_obs = n,
           n_clusters = G)
}

# Participant (cluster) bootstrap: draw participants with replacement and keep all of their decision blocks. Each draw
# gets a new participant id, so that a participant drawn twice enters as two clusters in a nested resample.
resample_participants <- function(data) {
    rows <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), data$participant_code)
    drawn <- sample.int(length(rows), length(rows), replace = TRUE)
    resample <- data[unlist(rows[drawn], use.names = FALSE), , drop = FALSE]
    resample$participant_code <- rep(seq_along(drawn), lengths(rows[drawn]))
    resample
}

## Goal weights from the pairwise comparisons
retrieve_alphas <- function(dataset) {
    # Drop rows without alpha (synthetic balancing rows) and use the English goal codes
    dataset <- na.omit(dataset) %>%
        mutate(task_name = str_replace_all(task_name, pattern = german_to_english))

    # Median weight per goal pair, pooling both orderings of the goals and expressed as the weight on goal_i, the
    # alphabetically first goal of the pair
    median_estimates <- dataset %>%
        separate_wider_delim(task_name, delim = "-", names = c("goal1", "goal2")) %>%
        mutate(goal_i = pmin(goal1, goal2),
               goal_j = pmax(goal1, goal2),
               alpha_i = ifelse(goal1 == goal_i, alpha, 1 - alpha)) %>%
        group_by(goal_i, goal_j) %>%
        summarize(median_alpha = median(alpha_i, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    stopifnot("Every goal pair needs a median alpha strictly between 0 and 1" =
                  nrow(median_estimates) == choose(length(goals), 2) &&
                  all(median_estimates$median_alpha > 0 & median_estimates$median_alpha < 1))

    # Reciprocal matrix of alpha ratios: c_ij = m_ij / (1 - m_ij) and c_ji = 1 / c_ij
    alpha_ratio_mat <- matrix(1, nrow = length(goals), ncol = length(goals), dimnames = list(goals, goals))
    alpha_ratio_mat[cbind(median_estimates$goal_i, median_estimates$goal_j)] <- median_estimates$median_alpha / (1 - median_estimates$median_alpha)
    alpha_ratio_mat[cbind(median_estimates$goal_j, median_estimates$goal_i)] <- (1 - median_estimates$median_alpha) / median_estimates$median_alpha

    # Logarithmic least-squares weights (Hovanov et al. 2008): geometric mean of each row, normalized to sum to 1
    alpha_weights <- apply(alpha_ratio_mat, 1, function(ratios) exp(mean(log(ratios))))
    alpha_weights <- alpha_weights / sum(alpha_weights)

    tibble(goal = names(alpha_weights), alpha_median = as.numeric(alpha_weights))
}

## Index score from goal scores
# CES aggregation (sum_i alpha_i x_i^(1 - eta))^(1 / (1 - eta)), with the geometric mean for eta = 1. eta is the same
# for all goals of a country, so only its first value is used.
calculate_OHI_score <- function(alpha_vector, score_vector, eta) {
    eta <- eta[1]
    if (eta == 1) return(prod(score_vector^alpha_vector)^(1 / sum(alpha_vector)))
    sum(alpha_vector * score_vector^(1 - eta))^(1 / (1 - eta))
}

## Merge survey answers
# Codes "ocean health importance" from 1 (not important at all) to 7 (very important), dropping "no opinion"
importance_levels <- c("not important at all", "not important", "rather not important", "undecided",
                       "rather important", "important", "very important")
add_survey_data <- function(data) {
    data %>%
        inner_join(survey_data %>% select(participant_code, gender, age, days_at_sea, ocean_health_importance, session_label),
                   by = "participant_code", multiple = "any") %>%
        filter(ocean_health_importance != "no opinion") %>%
        mutate(ocean_health_importance = match(ocean_health_importance, importance_levels),
               gender = factor(gender, levels = c("male", "female")))
}
```

# Sample preparation

```{r compute-prep}
# Computes all objects that depend on the sample selection: the selected decision blocks with their (alpha, eta)
# estimates, overall and country-level preferences, and OHI_table (one row per country and goal, with baseline and
# adjusted OHI scores). Used for the main sample and the sensitivity samples of SI Appendix Fig. S8:
#   unipref_eta: re-include the corner-solution blocks with alpha = 1 or 0 and this fixed eta
#   synthetic_fill: fill every participant up to three decision blocks
compute_prep <- function(sample_selection, unipref_eta = NULL, synthetic_fill = FALSE) {
    ## Selected decision blocks
    selected_blocks <- paste(sample_selection$participant_code, sample_selection$task_number)
    stopifnot(all(selected_blocks %in% paste(ohi_estimates_online_raw$participant_code, ohi_estimates_online_raw$task_number))) # No selected block missing from estimates
    data_decision_task_online <- data_decision_task_online_raw %>% filter(paste(participant_code, block_number) %in% selected_blocks)
    ohi_estimates_online <- ohi_estimates_online_raw %>% filter(paste(participant_code, task_number) %in% selected_blocks)

    ## Corner solutions (unipref sensitivity only)
    # alpha = 1 if goal 1 got more than half of the points on average, else 0; eta is fixed at unipref_eta
    if (!is.null(unipref_eta)) {
        dominant_goal_alpha <- data_decision_task_online %>%
            group_by(participant_code, block_number) %>%
            summarise(share_goal1 = mean(to_goal1 / (to_goal1 + to_goal2), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
            transmute(participant_code, task_number = block_number, assigned_alpha = ifelse(share_goal1 > 0.5, 1, 0))
        ohi_estimates_online <- ohi_estimates_online %>%
            left_join(dominant_goal_alpha, by = c("participant_code", "task_number")) %>%
            mutate(alpha = ifelse(!is.na(unipref) & unipref != 0, assigned_alpha, alpha),
                   eta   = ifelse(!is.na(unipref) & unipref != 0, unipref_eta, eta)) %>%
            select(-assigned_alpha)
    }

    ## Synthetic balancing (sensitivity only)
    # Add rows without alpha that carry the participant's mean eta until every participant has three decision blocks
    if (synthetic_fill) {
        ohi_estimates_online <- ohi_estimates_online %>%
            nest(blocks = -participant_code) %>%
            mutate(blocks = purrr::map(blocks, function(participant_blocks) {
                n_missing <- 3 - nrow(participant_blocks)
                if (n_missing <= 0) return(participant_blocks)
                synthetic_rows <- participant_blocks %>%
                    slice(rep(1, n_missing)) %>%
                    mutate(eta = mean(participant_blocks$eta, na.rm = TRUE), task_number = NA, alpha = NA, task_name = NA,
                           rho = NA, sigma = NA, nllsq_alpha = NA, unipref = NA)
                bind_rows(participant_blocks, synthetic_rows)
            })) %>%
            unnest(blocks)
    }

    ## Overall preferences
    ohi_estimates_online_eng <- ohi_estimates_online %>% mutate(task_name = str_replace_all(task_name, pattern = german_to_english))
    alpha_total_sample <- retrieve_alphas(ohi_estimates_online)
    eta_total_sample <- median(ohi_estimates_online$eta)

    ## Country-level preferences
    estimates_wcountry <- ohi_estimates_online %>%
        inner_join(distinct(data_decision_task_online, participant_code, session_label), by = "participant_code") %>%
        inner_join(country_codes, by = "session_label") %>%
        select(-session_label)

    # Goal weights per country
    alpha_per_country <- tibble()
    for (survey_country in unique(estimates_wcountry$region_name)) {
        alpha_country <- retrieve_alphas(filter(estimates_wcountry, region_name == survey_country)) %>%
            mutate(region_name = survey_country)
        alpha_per_country <- bind_rows(alpha_per_country, alpha_country)
    }

    # Median eta per country
    eta_per_country <- estimates_wcountry %>%
        summarise(eta_median = median(eta), .by = country_abrv)

    ## OHI_table: goal scores, preferences and adjusted scores per country in 2022
    base_OHI_2022 <- ohi_scores %>%
        filter(scenario == 2022, goal == "Index", dimension == "score", !is.na(value)) %>%
        select(country = region_name, base_OHI = value)

    OHI_table <- ohi_scores %>%
        filter(scenario == 2022, goal %in% goals, dimension == "score") %>%
        arrange(goal) %>%
        mutate(value = ifelse(region_name %in% tr_imputed_countries & goal == "TR", 100, value)) %>%
        group_by(region_name) %>%
        filter(!any(is.na(value))) %>% # Drop countries with a missing goal score
        ungroup() %>%
        transmute(country_code = country_codes$country_abrv[match(region_name, country_codes$region_name)],
                  country = region_name,
                  goal,
                  goal_score = value) %>%
        left_join(alpha_per_country, by = c("goal", "country" = "region_name")) %>%
        left_join(eta_per_country, by = c("country_code" = "country_abrv")) %>%
        # Countries outside the survey get the overall preferences
        mutate(alpha_global = alpha_total_sample$alpha_median[match(goal, alpha_total_sample$goal)],
               alpha_median = ifelse(is.na(alpha_median), alpha_global, alpha_median),
               eta_median = ifelse(is.na(eta_median), eta_total_sample, eta_median)) %>%
        left_join(base_OHI_2022, by = "country") %>%
        group_by(country) %>%
        mutate(
            # The official index of the TR-imputed countries averages only 9 goals: use the mean of all 10 goal scores
            base_OHI = ifelse(country %in% tr_imputed_countries, mean(goal_score), base_OHI),
            # Adjusted scores with the country preferences
            adjusted_OHI = calculate_OHI_score(alpha_median, goal_score, eta_median),
            # Adjusted scores with the overall preferences for all countries: weights and eta, weights only, eta only
            adjusted_OHI_global = calculate_OHI_score(alpha_global, goal_score, eta_total_sample),
            adjusted_OHI_alphaonly = calculate_OHI_score(alpha_global, goal_score, 0),
            adjusted_OHI_etaonly = calculate_OHI_score(rep(0.1, 10), goal_score, eta_total_sample)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        arrange(country)

    list(data_decision_task_online = data_decision_task_online,
         ohi_estimates_online = ohi_estimates_online,
         ohi_estimates_online_eng = ohi_estimates_online_eng,
         alpha_total_sample = alpha_total_sample,
         eta_total_sample = eta_total_sample,
         estimates_wcountry = estimates_wcountry,
         eta_per_country = eta_per_country,
         OHI_table = OHI_table)
}
```

```{r main-sample}
main_prep <- compute_prep(main_sample_subject_selection)
list2env(main_prep, envir = globalenv())

# One row per country, with the Gini coefficient of its goal scores
country_scores <- OHI_table %>%
    group_by(country) %>%
    mutate(gini = Gini(goal_score)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    distinct(country, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

# Plot functions

```{r plot-functions}
## Fig. 2a: goal weights, optionally with confidence intervals
plot_goal_weights <- function(weights_data, alpha_ci = NULL) {
    # With confidence intervals, TR's bar is too narrow for both labels: show its point estimate above the bar
    goals_label_above <- if (is.null(alpha_ci)) character(0) else "TR"

    panel <- ggplot(weights_data, aes(x = goal, y = alpha_median, fill = goal)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = goal_colors) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0.1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
        geom_text(aes(label = round(alpha_median, 3), vjust = ifelse(goal %in% goals_label_above | alpha_median >= 0.1, -0.5, 1.5)), size = 6 /.pt) +
        geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n), y = 0.023), angle = 90, vjust = 1.5, color = "black", size = 6 /.pt) +
        labs(x = "Goal", y = expression(paste("Weighting estimate (", alpha, ")"))) +
        annotate(geom = "text", label = "Equal weighting (1/N)", y = 0.11, x = 8.8, size = 7 /.pt) +
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(weights_data$alpha_median, 0.2)), breaks = c(0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
        theme_basic +
        theme_axes +
        theme(legend.position = "none",
              axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 7, size = 7),
              axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 7, margin = margin(r = 2)),
              axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
              axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
              axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, vjust = 3))

    if (!is.null(alpha_ci)) {
        goal_order <- as.character(weights_data$goal)
        ci_labels <- tibble(goal = weights_data$goal,
                            label = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", alpha_ci[1, goal_order], alpha_ci[2, goal_order]))
        panel <- panel +
            geom_text(data = ci_labels, aes(x = goal, y = 0.025, label = label),
                      angle = 90, hjust = 0.35, vjust = -0.5, size = 5 / .pt, inherit.aes = FALSE)
    }
    panel
}

## Fig. 2b and 2d: paired dot plot of baseline vs. adjusted country scores
# Long format with jittered x positions; scores has one row per country with base_OHI and adjusted_OHI
jitter_scores_long <- function(scores) {
    scores_long <- scores %>%
        select(country, base_OHI, adjusted_OHI) %>%
        pivot_longer(cols = c(base_OHI, adjusted_OHI), names_to = "name", values_to = "value") %>%
        mutate(x = ifelse(name == "base_OHI", 1, 2))
    scores_long$jittered_x <- jitter(scores_long$x, .1)
    scores_long
}

# Plot with the mean change and the p-value of a paired t-test; with ci_label, the CI is shown between the two
plot_score_shift <- function(scores_long, adjusted_name, adjusted_color, label_y, ci_label = NULL) {
    baseline <- scores_long$value[scores_long$x == 1]
    adjusted <- scores_long$value[scores_long$x == 2]
    mean_change <- (mean(adjusted, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(baseline, na.rm = TRUE)) / mean(baseline, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
    p_value <- t.test(baseline, adjusted, paired = TRUE)$p.value
    p_label <- paste0("(", ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "p<0.001", sprintf("p=%.3f", p_value)), ")")

    panel <- ggplot(data = scores_long, aes(y = value)) +
        geom_point(data = filter(scores_long, x == 1), aes(x = jittered_x), color = "#D55E00", size = 0.3, alpha = .5) +
        geom_point(data = filter(scores_long, x == 2), aes(x = jittered_x), color = adjusted_color, size = 0.3, alpha = .5) +
        geom_line(aes(x = jittered_x, group = country), color = 'lightgray', alpha = .5, linewidth = 0.1) +
        geom_half_boxplot(
            data = filter(scores_long, x == 1), aes(x = x, y = value), position = position_nudge(x = 1.25),
            side = "r", outlier.shape = NA, center = TRUE, errorbar.draw = TRUE, width = .07,
            alpha = .5, size = 0.2, fill = "#D55E00") +
        geom_half_boxplot(
            data = filter(scores_long, x == 2), aes(x = x, y = value), position = position_nudge(x = .3),
            side = "r", outlier.shape = NA, center = TRUE, errorbar.draw = TRUE, width = .07,
            alpha = .5, size = 0.2, fill = adjusted_color) +
        geom_half_violin(
            data = filter(scores_long, x == 2), aes(x = x, y = value), position = position_nudge(x = .05),
            side = "r", alpha = .5, trim = TRUE, size = 0.2, adjust = 0.6, width = 0.3, fill = adjusted_color) +
        geom_half_violin(
            data = filter(scores_long, x == 1), aes(x = x, y = value), position = position_nudge(x = 1.05),
            side = "r", alpha = .5, trim = TRUE, size = 0.2, adjust = 0.6, width = 0.3, fill = "#D55E00") +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("Baseline country scores", paste(adjusted_name, "country scores"))) +
        scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 95, 10)) +
        xlab("") + ylab("OHI score") +
        theme_classic() +
        coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.9, 2.6), ylim = c(0, 90)) +
        theme(
            axis.title = element_text(size = 7),
            axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
            axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
            axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
            axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
            plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 2, unit = "pt"))

    if (is.null(ci_label)) {
        panel + annotate("text", x = 2.50, y = label_y, label = paste(paste0(round(mean_change, 0), "%"), p_label, sep = "\n"), size = 7 /.pt)
    } else {
        panel +
            annotate("text", x = 2.515, y = label_y + 2, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", mean_change), size = 6 / .pt) +
            annotate("text", x = 2.515, y = label_y - 5, label = ci_label, size = 6 / .pt) +
            annotate("text", x = 2.515, y = label_y - 12, label = p_label, size = 6 / .pt)
    }
}

## Fig. 2e and SI Appendix Figs. S4, S8, S11: densities of baseline vs. adjusted country scores
# d has one row per country with base_OHI and adjusted_OHI; pct_x positions the %-change label. With ci_label, the
# %-change is shown with one decimal and the CI below it.
plot_ohi_density_panel <- function(d, panel_title = NULL, pct_x = 63, ci_label = NULL, pct_hjust = 0) {
    panel <- ggplot() +
        geom_density(data = d, aes(x = base_OHI), color = "#D55E00", fill = "#D55E00", alpha = 0.4) +
        geom_density(data = d, aes(x = adjusted_OHI), color = "#009E73", fill = "#009E73", alpha = 0.4) +
        # Mean baseline and adjusted scores
        geom_segment(data = d, aes(x = mean(base_OHI), xend = mean(base_OHI), y = 0, yend = 0.1, color = "Baseline", linetype = "Mean"), linewidth = 0.3) +
        geom_text(data = d, aes(x = mean(base_OHI), y = 0.1, label = round(mean(base_OHI), 0)), vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 7 /.pt, check_overlap = TRUE) +
        geom_segment(data = d, aes(x = mean(adjusted_OHI), xend = mean(adjusted_OHI), y = 0, yend = 0.1, color = "Adjusted", linetype = "Mean"), linewidth = 0.3) +
        geom_text(data = d, aes(x = mean(adjusted_OHI), y = 0.1, label = round(mean(adjusted_OHI), 0)), vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.7, size = 7 /.pt, check_overlap = TRUE) +
        # Arrow between the means
        geom_segment(data = d, aes(x = mean(adjusted_OHI), xend = mean(base_OHI), y = 0.095, yend = 0.095),
                     arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "cm"), ends = "first", type = "open", angle = 30), linewidth = 0.2)

    # %-change of the mean score
    if (is.null(ci_label)) {
        panel <- panel +
            geom_text(data = d, aes(x = pct_x, y = 0.096, label = paste0(round((1 - mean(adjusted_OHI) / mean(base_OHI)) * -100), "%")),
                      vjust = 0, hjust = pct_hjust, size = 7 /.pt, check_overlap = TRUE)
    } else {
        pct_change <- (mean(d$adjusted_OHI) - mean(d$base_OHI)) / mean(d$base_OHI) * 100
        panel <- panel +
            annotate("text", x = pct_x, y = 0.096, vjust = 0, hjust = 0, size = 7 / .pt, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_change)) +
            annotate("text", x = pct_x - 3, y = 0.091, label = ci_label, size = 7 / .pt, hjust = 0)
    }

    panel +
        labs(x = "OHI score", y = "Density", title = panel_title) +
        scale_x_continuous(limit = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0), breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)) +
        scale_y_continuous(limit = c(0, 0.11), expand = c(0, 0)) +
        scale_color_manual(breaks = c("Baseline", "Adjusted"), values = c("Baseline" = "#D55E00", "Adjusted" = "#009E73")) +
        scale_linetype_manual(breaks = c("Median", "Mean"), values = c("Median" = "solid", "Mean" = "dashed")) +
        theme_basic +
        theme_axes +
        theme(
            plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 2)),
            legend.position = "inside",
            legend.position.inside = c(0.13, 0.62),
            legend.background = element_blank(),
            legend.title = element_blank(),
            legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
            legend.spacing.x = unit(0, "mm"),
            legend.spacing.y = unit(-3, "mm"),
            legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "lines"),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 6, size = 7),
            axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 7, margin = margin(r = 2)),
            plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm"),
            axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7),
            axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7))
}

# Legend of the main Fig. 2e
```

## For text: Goal weights differ from equal weighting

```{r fig2-equal-weighting-test}
# Two-sided bootstrap-t tests of H0: alpha_i = 1/10 for every goal, with a nested participant bootstrap: B_outer
# resamples, each with B_inner inner resamples for its standard error. No output depends on this test and it is slow,
# so it is switched off by default; the reported results use the values below.
run_alpha_bootstrap <- FALSE
B_outer <- 1000
B_inner <- 200

if (run_alpha_bootstrap) {
    library(foreach)
    library(doParallel)
    library(doRNG)
    rng_state <- .Random.seed # doRNG changes the RNG kind: restored at the end

    cluster <- parallel::makeCluster(parallel::detectCores())
    registerDoParallel(cluster)
    registerDoRNG(123)
    parallel::clusterExport(cluster, c("retrieve_alphas", "resample_participants", "ohi_estimates_online",
                                       "goals", "german_to_english", "B_inner"), envir = environment())
    worker_packages <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "stringr", "purrr")

    # Standard errors of the weights on the original sample
    inner_draws <- foreach(s = seq_len(B_inner), .combine = bind_rows, .packages = worker_packages) %dorng% {
        retrieve_alphas(resample_participants(ohi_estimates_online))
    }
    se_hat <- inner_draws %>%
        group_by(goal) %>%
        summarize(se_hat = sd(alpha_median), .groups = "drop")

    # Outer resamples: weights and their standard errors from the nested resamples
    outer_draws <- foreach(b = seq_len(B_outer), .combine = bind_rows, .packages = worker_packages) %dorng% {
        outer_sample <- resample_participants(ohi_estimates_online)
        nested_draws <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(B_inner), function(s) retrieve_alphas(resample_participants(outer_sample)))
        retrieve_alphas(outer_sample) %>%
            rename(theta_star = alpha_median) %>%
            left_join(nested_draws %>% group_by(goal) %>% summarize(se_star = sd(alpha_median), .groups = "drop"), by = "goal")
    }

    parallel::stopCluster(cluster)
    assign(".Random.seed", rng_state, envir = globalenv())

    # p-values and bootstrap-t confidence intervals per goal
    alpha_ttest_results <- tibble()
    for (goal_tested in goals) {
        theta_hat <- alpha_total_sample$alpha_median[alpha_total_sample$goal == goal_tested]
        se_theta_hat <- se_hat$se_hat[se_hat$goal == goal_tested]
        stopifnot(is.finite(se_theta_hat), se_theta_hat > 0)

        goal_draws <- filter(outer_draws, goal == goal_tested)
        valid <- is.finite(goal_draws$theta_star) & is.finite(goal_draws$se_star) & goal_draws$se_star > 0 # Drop degenerate SEs
        theta_star <- goal_draws$theta_star[valid]
        t_star <- (theta_star - theta_hat) / goal_draws$se_star[valid]
        t_obs <- (theta_hat - 0.1) / se_theta_hat
        n_valid <- length(t_star)
        stopifnot(n_valid > 0)
        p_value <- min(1, 2 * min((1 + sum(t_star <= t_obs)) / (1 + n_valid), (1 + sum(t_star >= t_obs)) / (1 + n_valid)))
        t_quantiles <- unname(quantile(t_star, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)))

        alpha_ttest_results <- bind_rows(alpha_ttest_results, tibble(
            goal = goal_tested,
            mean_alpha = mean(theta_star),
            median_alpha = median(theta_star),
            t_obs = t_obs,
            t_crit_low = t_quantiles[1],
            t_crit_high = t_quantiles[2],
            p_value = p_value,
            conf_low = theta_hat - t_quantiles[2] * se_theta_hat,
            conf_high = theta_hat - t_quantiles[1] * se_theta_hat))
    }
    print(alpha_ttest_results)
}
```

```{r fig3-panel-a}
# Mean total change and its decomposition into weighting, substitutability and interaction effects
fig3a_effects <- OHI_table %>%
    mutate(total = adjusted_OHI_global - base_OHI,
           weighting = adjusted_OHI_alphaonly - base_OHI,
           substitutability = adjusted_OHI_etaonly - base_OHI,
           interaction = total - weighting - substitutability) %>%
    summarise(across(c(total, weighting, substitutability, interaction), mean))
```

# SI Appendix Fig. S9: Fig. 2 with Krinsky-Robb confidence intervals

```{r fig-s9-functions}
# Estimation uncertainty: for every decision block, draw (alpha, eta) from the sampling distribution of the Tobit
# estimates, N(estimate, inverse observed information), and rerun the Fig. 2 aggregation for each draw

## Tobit negative log-likelihood (transcription of 4_Code/Matlab_OHI/C_lolik.m)
nll <- function(par, shares, prices) { # par = c(alpha, eta, log(sigma))
    alpha <- par[1]
    eta <- par[2]
    sigm <- max(exp(par[3]), 1e-5)
    mu <- 1 / (1 + exp(((eta - 1) * log(prices) + log((1 - alpha) / alpha)) / eta))
    at_zero <- shares == 0
    at_one <- shares == 1
    interior <- !at_zero & !at_one
    ll <- numeric(length(shares))
    if (any(at_zero)) ll[at_zero] <- log(pnorm(-mu[at_zero] / sigm))
    if (any(at_one)) ll[at_one] <- log(pmax(1e-8, pnorm((1 - mu[at_one]) / sigm, lower.tail = FALSE)))
    if (any(interior)) ll[interior] <- -0.5 * (log(2 * pi) + log(sigm^2) + ((shares[interior] - mu[interior]) / sigm)^2)
    -sum(ll)
}

## Central-difference gradient and Hessian
fd_grad <- function(f, x) {
    step <- 1e-4 * pmax(abs(x), 1)
    g <- numeric(length(x))
    for (i in seq_along(x)) {
        x_plus <- x_minus <- x
        x_plus[i] <- x[i] + step[i]
        x_minus[i] <- x[i] - step[i]
        g[i] <- (f(x_plus) - f(x_minus)) / (2 * step[i])
    }
    g
}

fd_hessian <- function(f, x) {
    n <- length(x)
    step <- 1e-4 * pmax(abs(x), 1)
    H <- matrix(0, n, n)
    f0 <- f(x)
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
        x_plus <- x_minus <- x
        x_plus[i] <- x[i] + step[i]
        x_minus[i] <- x[i] - step[i]
        H[i, i] <- (f(x_plus) - 2 * f0 + f(x_minus)) / step[i]^2
        if (i < n) for (j in (i + 1):n) {
            f_shifted <- function(si, sj) {
                y <- x
                y[i] <- x[i] + si * step[i]
                y[j] <- x[j] + sj * step[j]
                f(y)
            }
            H[i, j] <- H[j, i] <- (f_shifted(1, 1) - f_shifted(1, -1) - f_shifted(-1, 1) + f_shifted(-1, -1)) / (4 * step[i] * step[j])
        }
    }
    H
}

## Fig. 2 quantities for a set of block estimates: %-changes of panels b, d, e, the weights (a) and median eta (c)
compute_fig2_summary <- function(estimates) {
    alpha_weights <- retrieve_alphas(estimates)
    eta_draw <- median(estimates$eta)
    scores <- OHI_table %>%
        mutate(alpha_draw = alpha_weights$alpha_median[match(goal, alpha_weights$goal)]) %>%
        group_by(country) %>%
        mutate(adj_full  = calculate_OHI_score(alpha_draw, goal_score, eta_draw),
               adj_alpha = calculate_OHI_score(alpha_draw, goal_score, 0),
               adj_eta   = calculate_OHI_score(rep(0.1, 10), goal_score, eta_draw)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        distinct(country, .keep_all = TRUE)
    base_mean <- mean(scores$base_OHI)
    list(summary = c(pct_alpha  = (mean(scores$adj_alpha) - base_mean) / base_mean * 100,
                     pct_eta    = (mean(scores$adj_eta)   - base_mean) / base_mean * 100,
                     pct_change = (mean(scores$adj_full)  - base_mean) / base_mean * 100),
         alpha = setNames(alpha_weights$alpha_median, alpha_weights$goal),
         eta = eta_draw)
}

## Fig. 2 with confidence intervals (also used for SI Appendix Fig. S10)
# ci: 2 x 3 matrix for panels b, d, e; alpha_ci: 2 x 10 matrix for panel a; eta_ci: CI of the median eta (panel c)
build_fig2_ci_figure <- function(ci, alpha_ci, eta_ci, filename) {
    ci_label <- function(panel) sprintf("[%+.1f, %+.1f]", ci[1, panel], ci[2, panel])
    panel_c_ci <- panel_fig2_c +
        annotate("text", x = eta_total_sample + 0.18, y = 0.47,
                 label = sprintf("%.2f  [%.2f, %.2f]", eta_total_sample, eta_ci[1], eta_ci[2]),
                 angle = -90, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 6 / .pt, colour = "#08519c")
    fig2_ci <- arrange_fig2(
        plot_goal_weights(panel_fig2_a_data, alpha_ci),
        plot_score_shift(panel_fig2_b_data_long, "Weighting-adjusted", "#88316F", label_y = 70, ci_label = ci_label("pct_alpha")),
        panel_c_ci,
        plot_score_shift(panel_fig2_d_data_long, "Substitutability-adjusted", "#08519c", label_y = 60, ci_label = ci_label("pct_eta")),
        plot_ohi_density_panel(panel_fig2_e_data, ci_label = ci_label("pct_change")) + fig2e_style)
    save_plot(filename = here("2_Graphs", filename), plot = fig2_ci, base_width = 7.2, base_height = 6.69)
}

## Point estimates of the Fig. 2 quantities
panels <- c("pct_alpha", "pct_eta", "pct_change")
base_mean <- mean(country_scores$base_OHI)
pts <- c(pct_alpha  = (mean(country_scores$adjusted_OHI_alphaonly) - base_mean) / base_mean * 100,
         pct_eta    = (mean(country_scores$adjusted_OHI_etaonly)   - base_mean) / base_mean * 100,
         pct_change = (mean(country_scores$adjusted_OHI_global)    - base_mean) / base_mean * 100)
alpha_pts <- setNames(alpha_total_sample$alpha_median, alpha_total_sample$goal)[goals]

# Prints the point estimates with their CIs
print_fig2_ci <- function(ci, alpha_ci, eta_ci) {
    for (p in panels) cat(sprintf("  %-11s point %+6.2f%%  95%% CI [%+6.2f%%, %+6.2f%%]\n", p, pts[p], ci[1, p], ci[2, p]))
    for (g in goals) cat(sprintf("  alpha[%-2s]   point %.3f   95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f]\n", g, alpha_pts[g], alpha_ci[1, g], alpha_ci[2, g]))
    cat(sprintf("  %-11s point %6.2f    95%% CI [%6.2f, %6.2f]\n", "eta_median", eta_total_sample, eta_ci[1], eta_ci[2]))
}
```

```{r fig-s9}
## Inputs: block-level estimates and the decisions of each block
block_estimates <- ohi_estimates_online
n_blocks <- nrow(block_estimates)
decisions <- data_decision_task_online %>% mutate(block = paste(participant_code, block_number))
shares_by_block <- split(decisions$to_goal1_p, decisions$block)
prices_by_block <- split(decisions$price_of_redist, decisions$block)

## Covariance of (alpha, eta) per block: inverse observed information
cov_by_block <- vector("list", n_blocks)
held_fixed <- logical(n_blocks) # Blocks held at the point estimate
grad_max <- rep(NA_real_, n_blocks) # Max. absolute gradient in (alpha, eta) at the estimate (convergence check)
for (b in seq_len(n_blocks)) {
    alpha_hat <- block_estimates$alpha[b]
    eta_hat <- block_estimates$eta[b]
    block_key <- paste(block_estimates$participant_code[b], block_estimates$task_number[b])
    shares <- shares_by_block[[block_key]]
    prices <- prices_by_block[[block_key]]
    # Corner solutions and estimates on the boundary have no interior covariance
    if (isTRUE(block_estimates$unipref[b] == 1) || alpha_hat <= 0 || alpha_hat >= 1 || eta_hat <= 0 || is.null(shares)) {
        held_fixed[b] <- TRUE
        next
    }
    block_nll <- function(par) nll(par, shares, prices)
    log_sigma_hat <- optimize(function(log_sigma) block_nll(c(alpha_hat, eta_hat, log_sigma)), interval = c(-12, 5))$minimum
    par_hat <- c(alpha_hat, eta_hat, log_sigma_hat)
    grad_max[b] <- max(abs(fd_grad(block_nll, par_hat)[1:2]))
    cov_full <- tryCatch(solve(fd_hessian(block_nll, par_hat)), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(cov_full) || any(!is.finite(cov_full))) {
        held_fixed[b] <- TRUE
        next
    }
    V <- cov_full[1:2, 1:2]
    if (V[1, 1] <= 0 || V[2, 2] <= 0 || (V[1, 1] * V[2, 2] - V[1, 2]^2) <= 0) { # Not positive definite
        held_fixed[b] <- TRUE
        next
    }
    cov_by_block[[b]] <- V
}

## Draws of (logit alpha, log eta), transformed back
n_kr_draws <- 1000
se_cap <- 5 # Blocks with a larger transformed SE are held at the point estimate
set.seed(123)
alpha_draws <- matrix(block_estimates$alpha, n_kr_draws, n_blocks, byrow = TRUE)
eta_draws <- matrix(block_estimates$eta, n_kr_draws, n_blocks, byrow = TRUE)
drawn <- logical(n_blocks)
n_se_capped <- 0L
for (b in which(!held_fixed)) {
    alpha_hat <- block_estimates$alpha[b]
    eta_hat <- block_estimates$eta[b]
    V <- cov_by_block[[b]]
    # Delta method: covariance of (logit alpha, log eta)
    jacobian_alpha <- 1 / (alpha_hat * (1 - alpha_hat))
    jacobian_eta <- 1 / eta_hat
    cov_transformed <- matrix(c(V[1, 1] * jacobian_alpha^2, V[1, 2] * jacobian_alpha * jacobian_eta,
                                V[1, 2] * jacobian_alpha * jacobian_eta, V[2, 2] * jacobian_eta^2), 2, 2)
    if (sqrt(cov_transformed[1, 1]) > se_cap || sqrt(cov_transformed[2, 2]) > se_cap) {
        n_se_capped <- n_se_capped + 1L
        next
    }
    L <- tryCatch(chol(cov_transformed), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(L)) next
    G <- matrix(rnorm(n_kr_draws * 2), n_kr_draws, 2) %*% L
    alpha_draws[, b] <- plogis(G[, 1] + qlogis(alpha_hat))
    eta_draws[, b] <- exp(G[, 2] + log(eta_hat))
    drawn[b] <- TRUE
}

## Fig. 2 quantities for every draw (row 1 = point estimate)
kr <- matrix(NA_real_, n_kr_draws + 1, 3, dimnames = list(NULL, panels))
alpha_goal_kr <- matrix(NA_real_, n_kr_draws + 1, length(goals), dimnames = list(NULL, goals))
eta_med_kr <- numeric(n_kr_draws + 1)
for (i in seq_len(n_kr_draws + 1)) {
    estimates_i <- block_estimates
    if (i > 1) {
        estimates_i$alpha <- alpha_draws[i - 1, ]
        estimates_i$eta <- eta_draws[i - 1, ]
    }
    res <- compute_fig2_summary(estimates_i)
    kr[i, ] <- res$summary[panels]
    alpha_goal_kr[i, ] <- res$alpha[goals]
    eta_med_kr[i] <- res$eta
}

## Percentile CIs
ci <- apply(kr[-1, , drop = FALSE], 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
alpha_ci <- apply(alpha_goal_kr[-1, , drop = FALSE], 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
eta_ci <- quantile(eta_med_kr[-1], probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Krinsky-Robb: %d blocks, %d drawn (%.0f%%), %d fixed (%d by se_cap = %g); max|grad(alpha,eta)| median=%.2g 90%%=%.2g\n",
            n_blocks, sum(drawn), 100 * mean(drawn), sum(!drawn), n_se_capped, se_cap,
            median(grad_max, na.rm = TRUE), quantile(grad_max, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE)))
print_fig2_ci(ci, alpha_ci, eta_ci)

# Row 1 reproduces the point estimates of Fig. 2
stopifnot(abs(kr[1, "pct_change"] - pts["pct_change"]) < 1e-6,
          abs(eta_med_kr[1] - eta_total_sample) < 1e-6,
          max(abs(alpha_goal_kr[1, ] - alpha_pts)) < 1e-6)
if (!(ci[1, "pct_change"] <= pts["pct_change"] && pts["pct_change"] <= ci[2, "pct_change"]))
    warning("Krinsky-Robb 95% CI for Panel 2e does not bracket the point estimate.")
if (!(eta_ci[1] <= eta_total_sample && eta_total_sample <= eta_ci[2]))
    warning("Krinsky-Robb 95% CI for the Panel 2c eta does not bracket the point estimate.")

build_fig2_ci_figure(ci, alpha_ci, eta_ci, "SI_Appendix_FigS9.pdf")
```

# For text (Methods): Social-choice interpretation

```{r social-choice}
# Weights fixed at the overall sample weights; countries of Fig. 2e. calculate_OHI_score() over- or underflows for the
# extreme right tail of eta (up to ~1e15), so the scores use the identical form m * (sum(alpha * (x/m)^(1-eta)))^(1/(1-eta))
# with m = min(x), vectorized over eta
ces_score_by_eta <- function(alpha_vector, score_vector, eta) {
    m <- min(score_vector)
    if (m == 0) { # A zero goal score gives a score of 0 for eta >= 1; below 1 the plain formula is stable
        out <- rep(0, length(eta))
        below_one <- eta < 1
        out[below_one] <- colSums(alpha_vector * outer(score_vector, 1 - eta[below_one], `^`))^(1 / (1 - eta[below_one]))
        return(out)
    }
    out <- m * as.vector(exp(outer(1 - eta, log(score_vector / m))) %*% alpha_vector)^(1 / (1 - eta))
    out[eta == 1] <- exp(sum(alpha_vector * log(score_vector)) / sum(alpha_vector))
    out
}

# Goal-score matrix (countries x goals), weights and baseline index
sc_scores <- OHI_table %>%
    select(country, goal, goal_score) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = goal, values_from = goal_score)
sc_goal_matrix <- as.matrix(sc_scores[, -1])
rownames(sc_goal_matrix) <- sc_scores$country
sc_alpha <- alpha_total_sample$alpha_median[match(colnames(sc_goal_matrix), alpha_total_sample$goal)]
sc_base <- OHI_table$base_OHI[match(rownames(sc_goal_matrix), OHI_table$country)]
sc_pct_change <- function(adjusted) (1 - mean(adjusted) / mean(sc_base)) * -100
sc_implied_scores <- function(eta) { # countries x eta
    t(matrix(vapply(seq_len(nrow(sc_goal_matrix)), function(k) ces_score_by_eta(sc_alpha, sc_goal_matrix[k, ], eta), numeric(length(eta))),
             nrow = length(eta), dimnames = list(NULL, rownames(sc_goal_matrix))))
}

# Decision-block (eta_ng) and participant-level (eta_n) parameters
sc_eta_blocks <- ohi_estimates_online$eta
sc_eta_participants <- eta_participant_level$eta
sc_scores_blocks <- sc_implied_scores(sc_eta_blocks)
sc_scores_at_median <- sc_implied_scores(median(sc_eta_blocks))[, 1]
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unname(sc_scores_at_median), country_scores$adjusted_OHI_global[match(rownames(sc_goal_matrix), country_scores$country)]))) # Same scores as Fig. 2e

# (1) Order of aggregation. Median: the score at the median eta equals the median of the implied scores. Mean: the
# score at the mean eta (Fig. S4d) differs from the mean of the implied scores.
cat(sprintf("Social choice (1) median: max |median of block-implied scores - score at median eta| = %.2g\n",
            max(abs(apply(sc_scores_blocks, 1, median) - sc_scores_at_median))))
cat(sprintf("Social choice (1) mean: score at mean eta (Fig. S4d, Leontief) %+.1f%% | mean of implied scores over decision blocks %+.1f%% | over participants (score at own eta_n) %+.1f%%\n",
            sc_pct_change(extdata_fig4_d_data$adjusted_OHI[match(rownames(sc_goal_matrix), extdata_fig4_d_data$country)]),
            sc_pct_change(rowMeans(sc_scores_blocks)),
            sc_pct_change(rowMeans(sc_implied_scores(sc_eta_participants)))))

# (2) Median of the decision-block estimates vs. median of the participant-level parameters
cat(sprintf("Social choice (2): median eta_ng = %.2f (%d decision blocks) vs. median eta_n = %.2f (%d participants)\n",
            median(sc_eta_blocks), length(sc_eta_blocks), median(sc_eta_participants), length(sc_eta_participants)))

# (3) Single crossing. Participant n ranks country A above B iff d_AB(eta_n) > 0. Per country pair: number of sign
# changes of d_AB over the sorted eta_n (differences below 1e-6 are ties), whether the participant majority contradicts
# the ranking at the median eta_n, and the three-country Condorcet cycles of the majority relation
sc_rank_scores <- sc_implied_scores(sort(sc_eta_participants))
sc_at_median_n <- sc_implied_scores(median(sc_eta_participants))[rownames(sc_rank_scores), 1]
sc_n <- nrow(sc_rank_scores)
sc_wins <- matrix(0, sc_n, sc_n)
sc_single_crossing <- 0
sc_reversals <- 0
for (i in 1:(sc_n - 1)) for (j in (i + 1):sc_n) {
    d_ab <- sc_rank_scores[i, ] - sc_rank_scores[j, ]
    sign_changes <- sum(diff(sign(d_ab[abs(d_ab) > 1e-6])) != 0)
    sc_single_crossing <- sc_single_crossing + (sign_changes <= 1)
    majority <- sign(sum(d_ab > 0) - sum(d_ab < 0))
    if (majority > 0) sc_wins[i, j] <- 1 else if (majority < 0) sc_wins[j, i] <- 1
    at_median <- sign(sc_at_median_n[i] - sc_at_median_n[j])
    sc_reversals <- sc_reversals + (majority != 0 && at_median != 0 && majority != at_median)
}
sc_pairs <- choose(sc_n, 2)
sc_tied_pairs <- sum(upper.tri(sc_wins) & sc_wins == 0 & t(sc_wins) == 0) # Pairs without a strict majority
# Directed 3-cycles i->j->k->i or i->k->j->i over all triples i < j < k
sc_cycles <- 0
for (i in 1:(sc_n - 2)) for (j in (i + 1):(sc_n - 1)) {
    k <- (j + 1):sc_n
    sc_cycles <- sc_cycles + sum(sc_wins[i, j] * sc_wins[j, k] * sc_wins[k, i] +
                                 sc_wins[i, k] * sc_wins[k, j] * sc_wins[j, i])
}
cat(sprintf("Social choice (3): d_AB changes sign at most once over the observed eta_n for %d of %d country pairs (%.1f%%); %d pairs (%.1f%%) where the participant majority contradicts the ranking at the median eta_n; %d three-country Condorcet cycles (%d countries)\n",
            sc_single_crossing, sc_pairs, 100 * sc_single_crossing / sc_pairs, sc_reversals, 100 * sc_reversals / sc_pairs,
            sc_cycles, sc_n))
cat(sprintf("  %d of %d country pairs have no strict majority (tied)\n", sc_tied_pairs, sc_pairs))
```

# For text and SI Appendix Tab. S4: Endogeneity of the preferences

## Substitutability eta

```{r endogeneity-eta}
# Median regression of the block-level log eta on the sum and the absolute difference of the two goals' 2022 scores in
# the participant's country, with goal-pair and country fixed effects and bootstrap SEs clustered by country:
#   ln eta_ng = theta (x_ic + x_jc) + phi |x_ic - x_jc| + pair FE + country FE + e_ng
n_boot_endog <- 200
eta_endog_data <- alpha_score_regression_data %>%
    mutate(score_sum = goal1_score + goal2_score,
           score_absdiff = abs(goal1_score - goal2_score),
           pair = factor(ifelse(goal1 < goal2, paste(goal1, goal2, sep = "-"), paste(goal2, goal1, sep = "-"))),
           country_code = factor(country_code))
stopifnot(!anyNA(eta_endog_data$score_sum), all(eta_endog_data$eta > 0))

eta_endog_model <- rq(log(eta) ~ score_sum + score_absdiff + pair + country_code, tau = 0.5, data = eta_endog_data, method = "fn")
set.seed(123)
eta_endog_coef <- summary(eta_endog_model, se = "boot", cluster = eta_endog_data$country_code, R = n_boot_endog)$coefficients

n_countries_endog <- nlevels(eta_endog_data$country_code)
eta_endog <- tibble(term = c("score_sum", "score_absdiff"),
                    estimate = eta_endog_coef[term, 1],
                    std.error = eta_endog_coef[term, 2],
                    p.value = 2 * pt(-abs(estimate / std.error), df = n_countries_endog - 1),
                    n_blocks = nrow(eta_endog_data),
                    n_participants = n_distinct(eta_endog_data$participant_code),
                    n_countries = n_countries_endog)
cat(sprintf("Eta endogeneity, %s: coefficient %.5f (%+.1f%% eta per 10 score points), p = %.3f (%d blocks, %d countries)\n",
            c("theta (sum of goal scores)", "phi (absolute difference of goal scores)"), eta_endog$estimate,
            100 * (exp(10 * eta_endog$estimate) - 1), eta_endog$p.value, eta_endog$n_blocks, eta_endog$n_countries), sep = "")
```

## Weights alpha

```{r endogeneity-alpha}
# Median regression of the block-level weight on goal 1 on the difference between the two goals' 2022 scores in the
# participant's country, with fixed effects for the ordered goal pair and bootstrap SEs clustered by country:
#   alpha_ng = gamma (x_ic - x_jc) + pair FE + e_ng
alpha_endog_data <- alpha_score_regression_data %>%
    mutate(score_diff = goal1_score - goal2_score,
           pair = factor(paste(goal1, goal2, sep = "-")), # Ordered, as alpha refers to goal 1
           country_code = factor(country_code))
stopifnot(!anyNA(alpha_endog_data$score_diff))

alpha_endog_model <- rq(alpha ~ score_diff + pair, tau = 0.5, data = alpha_endog_data, method = "fn")
set.seed(123)
alpha_endog_coef <- summary(alpha_endog_model, se = "boot", cluster = alpha_endog_data$country_code, R = n_boot_endog)$coefficients

alpha_endog <- tibble(term = "score_diff",
                      estimate = alpha_endog_coef[term, 1],
                      std.error = alpha_endog_coef[term, 2],
                      p.value = 2 * pt(-abs(estimate / std.error), df = nlevels(alpha_endog_data$country_code) - 1),
                      n_blocks = nrow(alpha_endog_data),
                      n_participants = n_distinct(alpha_endog_data$participant_code),
                      n_countries = nlevels(alpha_endog_data$country_code))
cat(sprintf("Alpha endogeneity, gamma (difference of goal scores): coefficient %.6f (%+.4f alpha per 10 score points), p = %.3f (%d blocks, %d countries)\n",
            alpha_endog$estimate, 10 * alpha_endog$estimate, alpha_endog$p.value, alpha_endog$n_blocks, alpha_endog$n_countries))
```

# SI Appendix Fig. S5: Demographics and goal weights

```{r fig-s5}
extdata_fig5_data <- add_survey_data(ohi_estimates_online_eng)

# Median regression of the weight on each goal, with country fixed effects
models <- list()
extdata_fig5_regression_data <- list() # Data of each model (participant clusters and SI Appendix Tab. S3)
goal_codes_sorted <- sort(goals)
for (goal_i in goal_codes_sorted) {
    # Blocks with the current goal, with alpha as the weight on that goal
    current_goal_table <- extdata_fig5_data %>%
        filter(str_detect(task_name, goal_i)) %>%
        mutate(alpha = ifelse(grepl(paste0(goal_i, "-"), task_name), alpha, 1 - alpha))
    models[[goal_i]] <- rq(alpha ~ age + gender + days_at_sea + ocean_health_importance + session_label,
                           tau = 0.5, current_goal_table)
    extdata_fig5_regression_data[[goal_i]] <- current_goal_table
}

# Confidence intervals from bootstrap SEs clustered by participant (wild gradient bootstrap of Hagemann (2017))
n_boot_rq <- 200
set.seed(123)
extdata_fig5_coef <- purrr::imap_dfr(
    models, ~ broom::tidy(.x, se.type = "boot", conf.int = TRUE, R = n_boot_rq,
                          cluster = extdata_fig5_regression_data[[.y]]$participant_code), .id = "model") %>%
    filter(term %in% demographics_terms) %>%
    mutate(model = factor(model, levels = rev(goal_codes_sorted)),
           term = factor(term, levels = demographics_terms))

extdata_fig5 <- ggplot(extdata_fig5_coef, aes(x = estimate, y = model, xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high, color = term)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 0.01, linewidth = 0.3) +
    # Estimates and CIs next to the dodged points
    geom_text(
        aes(x = estimate,
            y = as.numeric(model) + ifelse(term == "age", 0.35, ifelse(term == "genderfemale", 0.18, ifelse(term == "days_at_sea", -0.0, -0.17))),
            label = round(estimate, 3)),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0.5, size = 6 /.pt, color = "black") +
    geom_text(
        aes(x = -0.09,
            y = as.numeric(model) + ifelse(term == "age", 0.35, ifelse(term == "genderfemale", 0.17, ifelse(term == "days_at_sea", -0.02, -0.2))),
            label = paste0("CI: [", round(conf.low, 3), "; ", round(conf.high, 3), "]")),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 7 /.pt, color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(
        values = c("ocean_health_importance" = "#D55E00", "genderfemale" = "#F5C710", "days_at_sea" = "#0072B2", "age" = "#009E73"),
        labels = demographics_labels,
        name = NULL,
        guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
    ) +
    labs(y = "Goal", x = TeX("$\\alpha_{ng}$")) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 0.1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_basic +
    theme_axes +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 7, margin = margin(r = 2)),
          axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 6, size = 7),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
          axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = 4, size = 7),
          legend.position = "inside",
          legend.position.inside = c(0.9, 0.1),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

save_plot(filename = here("2_Graphs", "SI_Appendix_FigS5.pdf"),
          plot = extdata_fig5,
          base_width = 7.2, # 18.3cm in inch
          base_height = 6.69) # 17cm in inch (maximal allowed height)
```

# SI Appendix Fig. S7: Preferences and OHI scores

```{r fig-s7}
# Format a p-value, with "p < 0.001" for very small values
format_p <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.2f", p)

## Panel a: goal weights vs. goal scores of the sample countries
goal_alpha_score_data <- OHI_table %>%
    filter(country %in% sample_countries) %>%
    select(country, country_code, goal, goal_score, alpha_median) %>%
    filter(!is.na(goal_score), !is.na(alpha_median))

# Pooled correlation and within-goal slope (goal fixed effects); p-values clustered by country, as the weights of a
# country come from the same participants and sum to 1
alpha_r <- cor(goal_alpha_score_data$alpha_median, goal_alpha_score_data$goal_score, method = "pearson")
alpha_pooled_model <- lm(alpha_median ~ goal_score, data = goal_alpha_score_data)
alpha_p <- cluster_robust_coefs(alpha_pooled_model, goal_alpha_score_data$country_code) %>%
    filter(term == "goal_score") %>% pull(p.value)

alpha_fe_model <- lm(alpha_median ~ goal_score + factor(goal), data = goal_alpha_score_data)
alpha_fe_slope <- coef(alpha_fe_model)[["goal_score"]]
alpha_fe_p <- cluster_robust_coefs(alpha_fe_model, goal_alpha_score_data$country_code) %>%
    filter(term == "goal_score") %>% pull(p.value)

# Within-goal correlation: correlation of the goal-demeaned variables
alpha_r_within <- goal_alpha_score_data %>%
    group_by(goal) %>%
    mutate(alpha_dm = alpha_median - mean(alpha_median),
           score_dm = goal_score - mean(goal_score)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    summarise(r = cor(alpha_dm, score_dm)) %>%
    pull(r)

# Within-goal slope drawn through the grand means
alpha_fe_intercept <- mean(goal_alpha_score_data$alpha_median) - alpha_fe_slope * mean(goal_alpha_score_data$goal_score)

panel_extdata_fig7_alpha <- ggplot(goal_alpha_score_data, aes(x = goal_score, y = alpha_median)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3, color = "#D55E00") +
    geom_abline(intercept = alpha_fe_intercept, slope = alpha_fe_slope, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", color = "#0072B2") +
    geom_point(size = 1, color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf("Pooled: r = %.2f (%s)", alpha_r, format_p(alpha_p)), hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.6, size = 7 /.pt, color = "#D55E00") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf("Within goal: r = %.2f (%s)", alpha_r_within, format_p(alpha_fe_p)), hjust = 1.05, vjust = 3.1, size = 7 /.pt, color = "#0072B2") +
    labs(x = "OHI goal score (2022)", y = expression(paste("Weighting estimate (", alpha, ")"))) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.08))) +
    scatter_theme

## Panel b: median eta vs. baseline OHI score of the sample countries
country_correlation_data <- estimates_wcountry %>%
    group_by(country_abrv, country = region_name) %>%
    summarise(median_eta = median(eta, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(country_scores %>% select(country, base_OHI), by = "country") # Baseline incl. the recomputed index of the TR-imputed countries
eta_r <- cor(country_correlation_data$median_eta, country_correlation_data$base_OHI, method = "pearson")

# For text: Pearson correlation test (n = 12 countries)
print(cor.test(country_correlation_data$median_eta, country_correlation_data$base_OHI, method = "pearson"))

panel_extdata_fig7_eta <- ggplot(country_correlation_data, aes(x = base_OHI, y = median_eta)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3, color = "#D55E00") +
    geom_point(size = 1, color = "black") +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = country_abrv), size = 7 /.pt, color = "black", max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.1, point.padding = 0.0, seed = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = sprintf("Pearson r = %.2f", eta_r), hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.8, size = 7 /.pt) +
    labs(x = "OHI score (2022)", y = "Median eta") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.08))) +
    scatter_theme

extdata_fig7 <- ggdraw() +
    draw_plot(panel_extdata_fig7_alpha, x = 0.02, y = 0.03, width = 0.46, height = 0.92, scale = 1) +
    draw_plot(panel_extdata_fig7_eta, x = 0.52, y = 0.03, width = 0.46, height = 0.92, scale = 1) +
    draw_plot_label(c("a", "b"), x = c(0, 0.50), y = c(1, 1), size = 10)

save_plot(filename = here("2_Graphs", "SI_Appendix_FigS7.pdf"),
          plot = extdata_fig7,
```

```{r tab-s2}
                      goal_score = value,
                      eta_median = eta_total_sample,
                      alpha_median = alpha_total_sample$alpha_median[match(goal, alpha_total_sample$goal)])) %>%
    mutate(eta_median = round(eta_median, 2),
           alpha_median = round(alpha_median, 3)) %>%
    select(country_code, goal, goal_score, eta_median, alpha_median)

# Cells "goal score (alpha)", goals as rows and countries as columns
extdata_tab2_data <- extdata_tab2_data %>%
    unite(goal_value, goal_score, alpha_median, sep = "\n (") %>%
    mutate(goal_value = linebreak(paste(goal_value, ")", sep = ""), align = "l"))

extdata_tab2_data_wide <- extdata_tab2_data %>%
    rename(Eta = eta_median) %>%
    spread(key = goal, value = goal_value) %>%
    data.table::transpose(keep.names = "country_code", make.names = "country_code") %>%
    rename(`''` = country_code)

kable(extdata_tab2_data_wide, format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = F,
      linesep = "\\addlinespace", # Increase space between rows
      align = c(rep('l', ncol(extdata_tab2_data_wide)))) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), font_size = 8) %>%
    save_kable(file = here("2_Graphs", "SI_Appendix_TabS2.tex"))
```

```{r tab-s3}
fmt_n <- function(x) {
    x <- range(x)
    if (x[1] == x[2]) formatC(x[1], format = "d", big.mark = ",") else paste(formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ","), collapse = "--")
}
```

# SI Appendix Tab. S4: Endogeneity of the preferences

```{r tab-s4}
# Cell of a coefficient: estimate per 10 score points, bootstrap standard error in parentheses
endog_cell <- function(res, term) {
    r <- res[res$term == term, ]
    if (!nrow(r)) return("")
    num <- function(x) gsub("-", "$-$", sprintf("%.4f", 10 * x), fixed = TRUE)
    linebreak(sprintf("%s\n(%s)", num(r$estimate), num(r$std.error)), align = "c")
}
stopifnot(identical(eta_endog$n_blocks[1], alpha_endog$n_blocks[1])) # Both regressions use the same decision blocks

extdata_tab4_data <- tribble(
    ~row, ~eta, ~alpha,
    "Sum of goal scores, $x_{ic} + x_{jc}$", endog_cell(eta_endog, "score_sum"), endog_cell(alpha_endog, "score_sum"),
    "Absolute difference of goal scores, $|x_{ic} - x_{jc}|$", endog_cell(eta_endog, "score_absdiff"), endog_cell(alpha_endog, "score_absdiff"),
    "Signed difference of goal scores, $x_{ic} - x_{jc}$", endog_cell(eta_endog, "score_diff"), endog_cell(alpha_endog, "score_diff"),
    "N", fmt_n(eta_endog$n_blocks[1]), fmt_n(alpha_endog$n_blocks[1])
)

col_widths_tab4 <- c("6.5cm", "2.6cm", "2.6cm")
extdata_tab4 <- kable(extdata_tab4_data, format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = F,
      caption = "Endogeneity of preference parameters",
      label = "endogeneity",
      linesep = "\\addlinespace", # Increase space between rows
      align = c("l", "c", "c"),
      col.names = c("", "(1) $\\ln\\eta_{ng}$", "(2) $\\alpha_{ng}$")) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), font_size = 8) %>%
    row_spec(3, hline_after = TRUE)
for (i in seq_along(col_widths_tab4)) extdata_tab4 <- column_spec(extdata_tab4, i, width = col_widths_tab4[i])

# Table note directly below the table, as wide as the table (as for Table S3)
note_width_tab4 <- paste0("\\dimexpr ", paste(col_widths_tab4, collapse = " + "), " + ", 2 * (length(col_widths_tab4) - 1), "\\tabcolsep\\relax")
extdata_tab4[1] <- sub("\\bottomrule\n",
                       paste0("\\bottomrule\n\\multicolumn{", length(col_widths_tab4), "}{p{", note_width_tab4, "}}{\\rule{0pt}{1em}",
                              "\\textit{Note:} Median regressions on the decision-block level. The dependent variables are the substitutability ",
                              "$\\ln\\eta_{ng}$ (column 1) and the weight $\\alpha_{ng}$ on goal $i$ (column 2) of participant $n$ for goal pair $g$. ",
                              "Variables $x_{ic}$ and $x_{jc}$ are the 2022 OHI scores of goals $i$ and $j$ in the country $c$ of participant $n$. ",
                              "Coefficients are per 10 score points. Standard errors in parentheses are from a wild bootstrap clustered at the ",
                              "country level with ", fmt_n(n_boot_endog), " draws.}\\\\\n"),
                       extdata_tab4, fixed = TRUE)
stopifnot(grepl("\\textit{Note:}", extdata_tab4, fixed = TRUE)) # The note must have been placed
save_kable(extdata_tab4, file = here("2_Graphs", "SI_Appendix_TabS4.tex"))
```
